raw_text:
InvGate is a fast growing SaaS company that develops products for IT management and service automation, used by clients in over 60 countries in industries such as banking, e-commerce, education and technology.
To support our continuous growth, we are looking for a
Bilingual Application Support Analyst
to join our team. This is a client-facing role focused on ensuring our partners and customers get the most out of our platform by solving complex functional and technical challenges.
Some of the role´s responsibilities include:
Advanced Troubleshooting:
Act as the primary technical point of contact for external clients, diagnosing and resolving complex application issues.
Technical Consulting:
Guide clients on best practices for platform integration, workflow optimization, and advanced feature usage.
Cross-functional Collaboration:
Work closely with the Development and Customer Success teams to resolve our clients' requests and improve the product.
Do not hesitate to apply if you:
Are fluent in
English and Spanish
.
Enjoy working with clients and providing top-level support.
Have
2+ years of experience
supporting SaaS or complex enterprise applications for external users.
Have strong communication and troubleshooting skills.
Enjoy digging into
application logic and logs
to find the "why" behind an issue.
Have a passion for
learning new technologies
and products quickly, adapting to a high-speed, ever-evolving technical landscape.
It´s a big plus if you have experience with
Directory Services:
Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP for user authentication and management.
Environments:
Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems and experience working within virtualized environments.
Web Servers & Networking:
Administration of Apache and a solid understanding of network connectivity and protocols.
APIs:
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and tools like
Insomnia, Postman, or cURL
to test endpoints, analyze responses, and diagnose integration issues.
Databases:
Ability to write and execute
SQL queries
to perform data analysis required for the troubleshooting process.
We offer real opportunities for professional development, fully covered English classes, technical training both in-house and at educational centers, top-tier health insurance, a fixed amount for purchases in the food sector, reimbursement for remote work, and extended vacation and paternity leave.
Our office is located in Belgrano, CABA. This position is
Hybrid
for those residing in the AMBA region, requiring office attendance at least twice a week.
justification: The posting explicitly requires 2+ years of experience supporting SaaS or complex enterprise applications for external users as a mandatory condition. Under the ranking policy, when a posting explicitly requires 2+ years of professional experience as a mandatory requirement, the fit score must not exceed 39. Although the candidate possesses relevant technical knowledge (SQL, Linux, English/Spanish bilingualism) and the role is junior in title, the explicit 2+ YOE requirement creates a major professional experience barrier.
strengths: The role requires bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish; the candidate has strong bilingual communication skills.
The role mentions SQL and Linux as key or plus technologies; the candidate has practical experience with both SQL and Linux environments.
The position is located in Argentina / remote-compatible with the region and the title is Junior, aligning with the candidate's general entry-level scope.
gaps: The posting explicitly requires 2+ years of experience supporting SaaS or complex enterprise applications for external users.
The candidate profile indicates 0 formal professional years of experience (YOE).

About the role:
This opportunity gives you the chance to develop, maintain, and distribute our mobile apps, which are our core product, interacting with a deep tech problem directly in the application. We are looking for long-term players, professionals who are looking to grow and evolve with us over time. Additionally, individuals who have worked at product-focused companies tend to stand out, since they usually bring a deep understanding of building and scaling solutions with the end user in mind. Lastly, experience in start-up environments is highly regarded, as it often reflects adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-paced settings.
What you’ll do:
- Collaborate with product, design, and other engineers for new features.
- Design and implement key functionality in the apps.
- Develop tooling to improve our development practices.
- Participate in code reviews to raise the quality of our code and our product.
- Own your code in production.
- Work with our CX team when users are having trouble with the app.
What you’ll bring or Qualifications:
- Expertise in mobile SDKs and application development, including common design patterns.
- Our team possesses cross-team collaboration skills, and we are highly cross-functional, bringing everyone to the table to address our problems.
- A beginner’s mindset, always striving to understand.
- Own and solve problems.
- Willing and able to work on open problems.
- Being open to solving whatever needs to be solved.
Our Tech Stack
- iOS: Swift, UIKit, RxSwift, Golang.
- Android: Kotlin, RxJava, Golang
Interview Process
- Silver Screening Interview.
- Silver Technical Interview.
- Client Screening Interview.
- TakeHome Challenge.
- DeepDive Interview
- Behavioral Interview.
justification: La vacante solicita desarrollo, mantenimiento y distribución de aplicaciones móviles (iOS con Swift, UIKit, RxSwift o Android con Kotlin, RxJava) utilizando Golang. El perfil del candidato (Santiago Manjarín) abarca backend (Node.js, TypeScript, Python), C/C++ y bases de datos, pero no cuenta con experiencia ni proyectos demostrados en desarrollo móvil (iOS/Android, Swift, Kotlin o frameworks móviles). Al no haber requisitos formales de YOE o seniority, no aplica un tope duro de YOE, pero la brecha técnica en el stack principal (móvil) es total, situándolo como un ajuste débil.

strengths.text: La vacante busca profesionales en Argentina en formato híbrido con buen manejo de inglés y flexibilidad general, lo cual coincide con la ubicación y disponibilidad del candidato.

gaps.text: La vacante no especifica requisitos formales de experiencia o seniority, pero está orientada a desarrollo móvil (iOS/Android) con Golang, tecnologías y stack específico (Swift, Kotlin, SDKs móviles) no demostrados en el perfil del candidato.

COPERNIQ https://www.coperniq.io
ABOUT US
Coperniq is on a mission to revolutionize the renewable energy industry with cutting-edge software solutions. As a Y Combinator-backed startup, funded by Initialized Capital, we’re building the infrastructure for clean energy contractors to succeed. We’re looking for top-tier talent to scale with us.
ROLE OVERVIEW
We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead the development and scaling of our platform. As a key member of our small, dynamic team, you’ll collaborate across functions to deliver a seamless and powerful experience for our users. This role requires deep expertise in both frontend and backend technologies, as well as a passion for building robust, scalable systems. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are excited about making a significant impact in renewable energy, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Do:
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure full-stack solutions.
- Build and enhance web applications, ensuring a seamless user experience.
- Collaborate closely with product, design, and QA teams to align on requirements and deliver high-quality features.
- Define and implement best practices for software development and deployment.
- Optimize application performance and scalability for growing user demands.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
- Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the product roadmap.
What We’re Looking For:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field, with a deep understanding of software engineering principles.
- 7+ years of full-stack development experience, with a balanced skill set across frontend and backend. We are looking for profiles that are not purely frontend or backend — typically a 60/40 split in real project work in either direction.
- Proficient in our tech stack: AWS, React, GraphQL, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, MikroORM, PostgreSQL; experience with GitLab for CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
- Demonstrated experience in designing user interactions on websites, writing server-side API calls, and integrating front-end and back-end aspects of an application.
- Strong problem-solving skills, with a track record of working effectively in a dynamic environment.
- Excellent English skills and the ability to work as part of a team.
- Experience in leading projects, from conception to implementation to feedback integration.
Nice to Have:
- Experience in the renewable energy or SaaS industry.
- Knowledge of geolocation technologies and real-time data integration.
- Familiarity with SOC II compliance and secure development practices.
- Implementing voice agents
- Implementing docs/images editing/annotating with AI
What We Offer:
- A flexible work environment with opportunities for remote work.
- The chance to shape the future of clean energy.
- A collaborative, high-performance team culture.
Interview Process
- Silver Recruiter Screen
- Silver Technical Screen
- Behavioral Screen
- System Design Screen
- CEO Final Round
justification: La política de ranking establece que si una vacante requiere explícitamente 2 o más años de experiencia profesional como condición obligatoria (en este caso 7+ años), el puntaje no debe exceder de 39, independientemente de que el mensaje del empleador fomente postularse sin cumplir todos los requisitos. Aunque el candidato cuenta con habilidades en Node.js, TypeScript y PostgreSQL, la exigencia de 7+ años de experiencia profesional representa una barrera insalvable para un perfil junior/trainee sin experiencia formal.

strengths.text: El candidato posee proyectos académicos y personales utilizando TypeScript, Node.js y PostgreSQL, los cuales solapan parcialmente con parte del stack tecnológico secundario de la vacante.

gaps.text: La vacante requiere explícitamente 7+ años de experiencia en desarrollo full-stack. El candidato cuenta con 0 años de experiencia profesional formal.

Se requiere dominio profundo de un stack específico complejo (AWS, React, GraphQL, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, MikroORM, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD). El candidato tiene experiencia académica y proyectos personales en Node/TypeScript/PostgreSQL/Docker, pero carece de los 7+ años de trayectoria profesional exigidos.

Who is Securitize https://securitize.io
Securitize, the leader in tokenizing real-world assets with $3.7B+ AUM (as of May 5, 2025), is bringing the world on-chain through tokenized funds in partnership with top-tier asset managers, such as Apollo, BlackRock, Hamilton Lane, KKR, and others. Securitize, through its subsidiaries, is a SEC-registered broker-dealer, digital transfer agent, fund administrator, and operator of a SEC-regulated Alternative Trading System (ATS).
Securitize is a global, fully remote team consisting of top talent from the blockchain and financial services industries. Having raised $170M overall to date, we are backed by some of the largest names in finance and technology, including BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, Blockchain Capital, MUFG, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Sony Finance, Banco Santander, Coinbase, among others. Securitize has also been recognized as a 2025 Forbes Top 50 Fintech https://www.forbes.com/lists/fintech50/ company.
Before applying, we encourage you to visit us to learn more:
Website http://www.securitize.io/ | X/Twitter http://www.x.com/Securitize | LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/securitize
ABOUT THE ROLE:
We’re looking for a full-stack developer to join one of our core product teams.
Our product teams are responsible for building and maintaining the systems and APIs that power Securitize’s platform — from tokenization and investor management to data integrations and operational tools. You’ll collaborate with a distributed group of engineers to design and implement scalable, microservices-based infrastructure, robust API layers, and modern user interfaces that deliver a seamless experience for our customers.
As our products handle sensitive financial operations and potentially billions of dollars in transactions, reliability, correctness, and extensibility are essential. You’ll be expected to build solutions that are secure, testable, and efficient — while balancing flexibility and delivery timelines.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
As a full-stack developer, you’ll own end-to-end feature delivery, implementing both backend services and frontend components. You should have a strong sense of how your work fits into the broader system architecture and be comfortable designing solutions that integrate smoothly with other parts of the platform.
KNOWLEDGE:
- Extensive NodeJS and Python development experience (typescript experience a plus).
- Extensive experience with databases (both relational and non relational).
- Work Experience in React.
- Basic working knowledge of blockchain - a plus
- Security - Experience with implementation of highly secure systems - a plus.
- AWS and Kubernetes (K8s) experience – a plus.
QUALIFICATIONS:
- Minimum of 5 years of professional development experience.
- Experience in implementing complex front-end systems interacting with sophisticated back-ends (including micro services, routing, state management, authentication, performance, and others).
- Understanding of UI – you should understand intuitively what makes sense in a UI of a system and be concerned about each component being pixel perfect.
- Self-reliance; being able to come up with solutions to problems without super-detailed instructions.
- While experience is not required, interest in the fintech and blockchain worlds is a must.
- Eye for detail and an ability to fill in the blanks in product requirements.
WHY JOIN US?
Become a part of our rapidly expanding organization and enjoy a supportive and rewarding work environment:
BENEFITS:
- Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) – Promoting a healthy work-life balance.
- Equity Grant Opportunities – Share in the success and future growth of the company.
- Remote Work Flexibility – Work from anywhere while staying connected with a dynamic and collaborative team.
THE SELECTION PROCESS
- Silver.dev http://Silver.dev Recruiter Screen
- Silver.dev http://Silver.dev Live Coding Screen
- Client Technical Interview
- Client Live Coding
- Final Interview

Metabase https://www.metabase.com is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That's why people love us https://www.metabase.com/love.
We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies.
Metabase is looking for a customer-focused, highly technical Success Engineer to join our growing global team. We are looking for someone who loves data, enjoys helping others, and is excited to work for a startup to help our customers get the most out of Metabase.
Our customers are software engineers, data engineers, and data analysts, and they appreciate getting help and advice from experts just like them.
What you’ll do
- Talk to our users to understand their goals and challenges
- Help customers design and optimize their Metabase implementation
- Guide customers how to get data from all the various places it lives, transform it into useful shapes, and convert their questions into actual queries that can be executed.
- Solve complex problems and troubleshoot customer issues
- Collaborate with our technical communicators to create educational materials for our customers
- Serve as the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams and help drive product development
About you
- Enjoy helping people and solving their problems
- Strong technical background with 3+ years of experience writing production code, administering systems, and/or managing databases
- Strong database and SQL skills
An expert in at least two:
1. Designing and developing web applications.
2. Managing infrastructure (Docker, AWS/GCP/etc, or similar)
3. Managing databases
Nice to have
- Experience with Metabase or other BI tools
- Experience working for an open source product
- Fluency in multiple languages (this is helpful as our users are worldwide)
Interview Process
- Silver Recruiter Screening.
- Silver Technical Interview (Live coding)
- Client Screening Interview
- 3 x 1 Success team Interview
- Takehome Challenge and Review.
Why join us?
- We operate as a fully remote, async team. Work where and when you’re most productive - we trust you to get your work done. Meetings are rare, efficient, and your time is respected.
- Every week brings new complex challenges and opportunities to learn. If you thrive on solving complex problems and enjoy continuous learning, you'll find this role exciting and engaging.
- You’ll contribute to a tool that empowers users to unlock insights in their data without relying on a data team.
We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We're relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come.

Full-Stack Product Engineer
Build across the stack · Own features end-to-end · Ship continuously
The Role
We’re looking for a Full-Stack Product Engineer who loves building products — not just writing code. You’ll own features end-to-end: understanding customer problems, designing solutions, and shipping them to production. You’ll collaborate across the company while helping shape both the product and the engineering behind it.
We move quickly, ship continuously, and value engineers with strong product intuition as much as technical excellence.
What You’ll Do
- Help move products from idea to the hands of customers, contributing across problem definition, design, and delivery.
- Collaborate with stakeholders and teammates to understand needs and turn them into shipped features.
- Make product and technical decisions independently, with the autonomy and judgment to move without waiting for sign-off at every turn.
- Build across the entire stack — frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
Ship early, learn quickly, and iterate based on real customer feedback.
Our Tech Stack
- Frontend: Angular, TypeScript
- Backend: Django, Python, PostgreSQL
- Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
- We care far more about strong engineering fundamentals, product thinking, and a willingness to learn than experience with a particular framework.
How We Use AI
AI is part of how we build, not what we build.
We use modern AI tools to accelerate development, improve quality, and automate repetitive work so engineers can focus on solving meaningful problems. We embrace experimentation, but engineering judgment always comes first.
We continuously improve how we build software through design reviews, code walkthroughs, knowledge sharing, and experimenting with the latest developer tools.
What We’re Looking For
• Strong full-stack engineering skills.
• A product mindset and customer-first thinking.
• Ownership and the ability to work independently.
• Curiosity and a willingness to learn.
• Clear communication and collaboration.
• Pragmatic engineering judgment.
Our Values
Ideas Over Titles — The best ideas win, regardless of where they come from. We value intellectual honesty and healthy debate over hierarchy.
Better Over Perfect — We believe in shipping, learning, and continuously improving instead of waiting for perfect solutions.
Courage Over Comfort — We challenge assumptions, give candid feedback, and do what’s right for our customers and teammates — even when it’s uncomfortable.

ABOUT CANALS
Canals builds software for wholesale distributors, helping them operate more efficiently through automation and AI.
Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Every day, thousands of people rely on Canals to help process orders, manage purchasing, handle accounts payable, and streamline critical business workflows.
We're a profitable, rapidly growing company with a team of roughly 100 people distributed across North and South America. We care deeply about building great products, hiring exceptional people, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.
THE ROLE
Our customer base is growing fast, and we’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer eager to learn and grow with us. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers building scalable, high-performance systems that solve real-world problems in logistics and automation.
This is a great opportunity to gain exposure to modern engineering practices, real customers, and a product that delivers measurable business impact.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Work closely with senior engineers to design, build, and maintain backend systems that power our platform.
- Contribute to feature development, bug fixes, and performance improvements.
- Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and maintainability.
- Collaborate with product and design teams to bring ideas from concept to production.
- Learn new tools and technologies, and grow into greater ownership over time.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
- Typically, 0–2 years of professional experience as a software engineer (internships or projects count!).
- Solid programming fundamentals and familiarity with at least one backend language (Go, Python, Node, etc.).
- Curiosity and a desire to understand how complex systems fit together.
- Eagerness to learn from others and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
- Interest in startups, AI, or logistics a plus.
WHY JOIN CANALS
We're building software that solves real problems for an industry that keeps the world running. Our customers rely on our platform every day to operate their businesses.
We've found strong product-market fit and continue to grow quickly, creating opportunities for people who want to have a meaningful impact on the trajectory of a company.
We believe great people build great companies. That's why we invest heavily in hiring, development, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.
You'll work alongside ambitious, thoughtful teammates who care deeply about what they do, challenge each other directly, and have a lot of fun along the way.
We value ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement. Good ideas can come from anywhere, and people are trusted to make things happen.
